# Analysis plan: effect of BMI on systolic blood pressure

Two-sample Mendelian randomization with summary statistics. Written before any analysis. All data are simulated.

## Question

What is the causal effect of body mass index (BMI) on systolic blood pressure (SBP), in **mmHg per 1 kg/m² higher BMI**?

## Data

`data/main/exposure_bmi_gwas.tsv` (BMI instruments) and `data/main/outcome_sbp_gwas.tsv` (the same variants looked up
in an SBP GWAS). Column definitions, units and coding are in `data/DATA_DICTIONARY.md`.

## Steps

1. **Read and clean.** Treat the outcome missing-value code as missing. Drop instruments with no usable outcome data.
2. **Harmonise** every variant so that the exposure and outcome effects refer to the same allele (the exposure effect
   allele). Resolve strand differences by complementing alleles. For palindromic variants (A/T or C/G), infer the strand
   from allele frequency when the minor allele frequency is at most 0.42; otherwise drop the variant. Record the
   harmonisation action for every variant.
3. **Units.** Express exposure effects per kg/m² (1 SD of BMI = 4.8 kg/m²).
4. **Estimate.** Primary: inverse-variance weighted (IVW), multiplicative random effects. Sensitivity: MR-Egger
   (report the intercept) and weighted median. Report Cochran's Q for IVW.
5. **Outputs.**
   - `results/harmonisation_log.csv`: one row per variant, with its harmonisation action and whether it was used
   - `results/estimates.csv`: `method, estimate, se, ci_lower, ci_upper, n_snps`
   - `results/figures/scatter.png`: SNP–outcome against SNP–exposure effects, with the fitted lines
   - `report.md`: at most 200 words for the research group

# Data dictionary

> **All data in this folder are SIMULATED** for the IEU AI-for-coding workshop. They describe no real people,
> variants or GWAS. Variant identifiers are synthetic.

## Folders

Each folder holds one exposure GWAS file and one outcome GWAS file in the same formats.

| Folder | Purpose | True causal effect of BMI on SBP |
|---|---|---|
| `control_positive/` | Control dataset with a known answer | **+0.30 mmHg per 1 kg/m²** |
| `main/` | The dataset for the research question | Unknown |

## `exposure_bmi_gwas.tsv` (exposure: body mass index)

Genetic instruments for BMI from a GWAS of 300,000 people: independent variants (r² < 0.001) associated with BMI at
P < 5×10⁻⁸, pre-selected by the exposure consortium. The exposure consortium does not guarantee which DNA strand
alleles are reported on.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SNP` | Variant identifier |
| `CHR`, `POS` | Chromosome and position (GRCh38) |
| `EFFECT_ALLELE` | Allele whose effect is reported |
| `OTHER_ALLELE` | Other allele |
| `EAF` | Frequency of `EFFECT_ALLELE` |
| `BETA` | Per-copy effect of `EFFECT_ALLELE` on BMI, in **standard-deviation units** (1 SD of BMI = 4.8 kg/m²) |
| `SE` | Standard error of `BETA` (same units) |
| `P` | P-value |
| `N` | Sample size |

## `outcome_sbp_gwas.tsv` (outcome: systolic blood pressure)

Look-up of the BMI instruments in a separate GWAS of SBP (750,000 people, no sample overlap with the exposure GWAS).
Alleles are reported on the forward strand of GRCh38. Some instruments were not available in the outcome GWAS.
**Missing values are coded as `-9`.**

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `rsid` | Variant identifier |
| `chr`, `pos` | Chromosome and position (GRCh38) |
| `A1` | Reference allele |
| `A2` | Alternative allele. **`beta` and `freq` refer to `A2`** |
| `freq` | Frequency of `A2` |
| `beta` | Per-copy effect of `A2` on SBP, in mmHg |
| `se` | Standard error of `beta` |
| `pval` | P-value |
| `n` | Sample size |

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# Two-sample MR: effect of BMI on systolic blood pressure (mmHg per 1 kg/m2).
# Implements analysis_plan.md. Base R only.
#
# Usage: Rscript analysis/mr_analysis.R [dataset_folder] [output_folder]
#   dataset_folder  default "data/main"
#   output_folder   default "."  (results/ and report.md are written under it)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
data_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1) args[1] else "data/main"
out_dir  <- if (length(args) >= 2) args[2] else "."

SD_BMI_KGM2 <- 4.8      # 1 SD of BMI in kg/m2 (data dictionary)
MAF_PALINDROME_MAX <- 0.42
MISSING_CODE <- -9
N_BOOT <- 1000
set.seed(20240101)

dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "results", "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. Read and clean
exp <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "exposure_bmi_gwas.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
out <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "outcome_sbp_gwas.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# outcome missing code -> NA (in every numeric column)
for (v in c("chr", "pos", "freq", "beta", "se", "pval", "n")) {
  if (v %in% names(out)) out[[v]][out[[v]] %in% MISSING_CODE] <- NA
}
exp$EFFECT_ALLELE <- toupper(trimws(exp$EFFECT_ALLELE))
exp$OTHER_ALLELE  <- toupper(trimws(exp$OTHER_ALLELE))
out$A1 <- toupper(trimws(out$A1))
out$A2 <- toupper(trimws(out$A2))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(exp$SNP))
if (anyDuplicated(out$rsid)) {
  warning("Duplicated rsid in outcome file; keeping first occurrence of each.")
  out <- out[!duplicated(out$rsid), ]
}

comp <- function(a) chartr("ACGT", "TGCA", a)
is_palindromic <- function(a1, a2) paste0(a1, a2) %in% c("AT", "TA", "CG", "GC")

# One row per exposure variant; the log is built from this table.
d <- merge(exp, out[, c("rsid", "A1", "A2", "freq", "beta", "se")],
           by.x = "SNP", by.y = "rsid", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
names(d)[names(d) == "A1"]   <- "out_A1"
names(d)[names(d) == "A2"]   <- "out_A2"
names(d)[names(d) == "freq"] <- "out_freq"
names(d)[names(d) == "beta"] <- "out_beta"
names(d)[names(d) == "se"]   <- "out_se"
d <- d[match(exp$SNP, d$SNP), ]   # keep exposure file order

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. Harmonise
# Goal: out_beta_h = effect of the EXPOSURE effect allele on SBP.
d$action <- NA_character_
d$used   <- FALSE
d$beta_y <- NA_real_

for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
  ea <- d$EFFECT_ALLELE[i]; oa <- d$OTHER_ALLELE[i]
  a1 <- d$out_A1[i];        a2 <- d$out_A2[i]   # outcome beta refers to a2

  if (is.na(a2) || is.na(a1)) {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: not in outcome GWAS"; next
  }
  if (is.na(d$out_beta[i]) || is.na(d$out_se[i]) || d$out_se[i] <= 0) {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: outcome beta/se missing"; next
  }

  if (is_palindromic(ea, oa)) {
    maf_x <- min(d$EAF[i], 1 - d$EAF[i])
    maf_y <- if (is.na(d$out_freq[i])) NA else min(d$out_freq[i], 1 - d$out_freq[i])
    if (is.na(maf_y) || maf_x > MAF_PALINDROME_MAX || maf_y > MAF_PALINDROME_MAX) {
      d$action[i] <- "dropped: palindromic, MAF > 0.42 (strand ambiguous)"; next
    }
    if (!((a2 == ea && a1 == oa) || (a2 == oa && a1 == ea))) {
      d$action[i] <- "dropped: alleles do not match"; next
    }
    # Frequency of the exposure effect allele in the outcome if strands agree:
    f_same <- if (a2 == ea) d$out_freq[i] else 1 - d$out_freq[i]
    same_strand <- abs(d$EAF[i] - f_same) <= abs(d$EAF[i] - (1 - f_same))
    # Strands agree -> align by letter. Strands differ -> letters are swapped
    # relative to the same-strand reading, so the alignment is reversed.
    flip <- if (same_strand) (a2 == oa) else (a2 == ea)
    d$beta_y[i] <- if (flip) -d$out_beta[i] else d$out_beta[i]
    d$action[i] <- paste0("palindromic, strand inferred from EAF (",
                          if (same_strand) "same strand" else "opposite strand",
                          if (flip) ", sign flipped)" else ", no flip)")
    d$used[i] <- TRUE
    next
  }

  if (a2 == ea && a1 == oa) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- d$out_beta[i];  d$action[i] <- "aligned: no change"
  } else if (a2 == oa && a1 == ea) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- -d$out_beta[i]; d$action[i] <- "aligned: outcome alleles swapped, sign flipped"
  } else if (comp(a2) == ea && comp(a1) == oa) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- d$out_beta[i];  d$action[i] <- "strand flip: complemented, no sign change"
  } else if (comp(a2) == oa && comp(a1) == ea) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- -d$out_beta[i]; d$action[i] <- "strand flip: complemented, sign flipped"
  } else {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: alleles do not match"; next
  }
  d$used[i] <- TRUE
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. Units
# Exposure: SD units -> per kg/m2. Outcome already mmHg, so ratios are mmHg per kg/m2.
d$beta_x <- d$BETA / SD_BMI_KGM2
d$se_x   <- d$SE   / SD_BMI_KGM2
d$se_y   <- d$out_se

log_df <- data.frame(SNP = d$SNP, CHR = d$CHR, POS = d$POS,
                     exposure_effect_allele = d$EFFECT_ALLELE, exposure_other_allele = d$OTHER_ALLELE,
                     exposure_EAF = d$EAF, outcome_A1 = d$out_A1, outcome_A2 = d$out_A2,
                     outcome_freq_A2 = d$out_freq,
                     action = d$action, used = d$used)
write.csv(log_df, file.path(out_dir, "results", "harmonisation_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

m <- d[d$used, c("SNP", "beta_x", "se_x", "beta_y", "se_y")]
n <- nrow(m)
cat(sprintf("%d of %d exposure variants used after harmonisation\n", n, nrow(d)))
print(table(sub(":.*|,.*| \\(.*", "", d$action)))
if (n < 4) stop("Too few instruments for the sensitivity analyses.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. Estimation
bx <- m$beta_x; by <- m$beta_y; sy <- m$se_y; sx <- m$se_x

# --- IVW, multiplicative random effects (first-order weights 1/se_y^2).
# Slope through origin; residual variance scales the SE, floored at 1
# (no under-dispersion correction). CI uses t with n-1 df.
ivw_fit <- lm(by ~ 0 + bx, weights = 1 / sy^2)
ivw_est <- unname(coef(ivw_fit))
ivw_se_fixed <- summary(ivw_fit)$coefficients[1, 2] / summary(ivw_fit)$sigma
Q <- sum(residuals(ivw_fit)^2 / sy^2)            # Cochran's Q, df = n-1
Q_df <- n - 1
Q_p <- pchisq(Q, Q_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
I2 <- max(0, (Q - Q_df) / Q)
ivw_se <- ivw_se_fixed * max(1, sqrt(Q / Q_df))
ivw_t <- qt(0.975, Q_df)

# --- MR-Egger: orient so every bx is positive, then WLS with intercept.
sg <- sign(bx); sg[sg == 0] <- 1
bx_o <- bx * sg; by_o <- by * sg
egger_fit <- lm(by_o ~ bx_o, weights = 1 / sy^2)
egger_sum <- summary(egger_fit)$coefficients
egger_sigma <- max(1, summary(egger_fit)$sigma)
egger_df <- n - 2
egger_t <- qt(0.975, egger_df)
egger_int <- egger_sum[1, 1]; egger_int_se <- egger_sum[1, 2] / summary(egger_fit)$sigma * egger_sigma
egger_slope <- egger_sum[2, 1]; egger_slope_se <- egger_sum[2, 2] / summary(egger_fit)$sigma * egger_sigma
egger_int_p <- 2 * pt(-abs(egger_int / egger_int_se), egger_df)

# --- Weighted median (Bowden 2016), first-order weights, bootstrap SE.
weighted_median <- function(b, w) {
  o <- order(b); b <- b[o]; w <- w[o] / sum(w)
  p <- cumsum(w) - 0.5 * w
  below <- max(which(p < 0.5))
  b[below] + (b[below + 1] - b[below]) * (0.5 - p[below]) / (p[below + 1] - p[below])
}
wm_est_fun <- function(bx, by, sx_unused, sy) {
  ratio <- by / bx
  se_ratio <- sy / abs(bx)
  weighted_median(ratio, 1 / se_ratio^2)
}
wm_est <- wm_est_fun(bx, by, sx, sy)
wm_boot <- replicate(N_BOOT, {
  bxb <- rnorm(n, bx, sx); byb <- rnorm(n, by, sy)
  wm_est_fun(bxb, byb, sx, sy)
})
wm_se <- sd(wm_boot)

ci <- function(est, se, crit) c(est - crit * se, est + crit * se)
estimates <- data.frame(
  method = c("IVW (multiplicative random effects)", "MR-Egger slope", "MR-Egger intercept", "Weighted median"),
  estimate = c(ivw_est, egger_slope, egger_int, wm_est),
  se = c(ivw_se, egger_slope_se, egger_int_se, wm_se),
  ci_lower = c(ci(ivw_est, ivw_se, ivw_t)[1], ci(egger_slope, egger_slope_se, egger_t)[1],
               ci(egger_int, egger_int_se, egger_t)[1], ci(wm_est, wm_se, qnorm(0.975))[1]),
  ci_upper = c(ci(ivw_est, ivw_se, ivw_t)[2], ci(egger_slope, egger_slope_se, egger_t)[2],
               ci(egger_int, egger_int_se, egger_t)[2], ci(wm_est, wm_se, qnorm(0.975))[2]),
  n_snps = n)
write.csv(estimates, file.path(out_dir, "results", "estimates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(estimates, digits = 4)
cat(sprintf("Cochran's Q (IVW) = %.2f on %d df, P = %.3g, I2 = %.0f%%\n", Q, Q_df, Q_p, 100 * I2))
cat(sprintf("MR-Egger intercept P = %.3g\n", egger_int_p))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Figure
png(file.path(out_dir, "results", "figures", "scatter.png"), width = 1600, height = 1400, res = 220)
xr <- range(c(0, bx_o - 1.96 * sx, bx_o + 1.96 * sx))
yr <- range(c(0, by_o - 1.96 * sy, by_o + 1.96 * sy))
plot(bx_o, by_o, xlim = xr, ylim = yr, pch = 19, col = "grey30",
     xlab = "SNP effect on BMI (kg/m2 per allele)",
     ylab = "SNP effect on SBP (mmHg per allele)",
     main = "BMI -> SBP: SNP-outcome vs SNP-exposure effects")
segments(bx_o, by_o - 1.96 * sy, bx_o, by_o + 1.96 * sy, col = "grey70")
segments(bx_o - 1.96 * sx, by_o, bx_o + 1.96 * sx, by_o, col = "grey70")
abline(h = 0, v = 0, lty = 3, col = "grey60")
abline(a = 0, b = ivw_est, col = "#0072B2", lwd = 2)
abline(a = egger_int, b = egger_slope, col = "#D55E00", lwd = 2)
abline(a = 0, b = wm_est, col = "#009E73", lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", bty = "n", lwd = 2, col = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73"),
       legend = c("IVW", "MR-Egger", "Weighted median"))
dev.off()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- report.md (<= 200 words)
n_drop <- nrow(d) - n
f <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
report <- c(
  "# BMI and systolic blood pressure: two-sample MR (simulated data)",
  "",
  sprintf("Dataset: `%s`. %d of %d BMI instruments were used; %d dropped (missing in the outcome GWAS or ambiguous palindromic variants; see `results/harmonisation_log.csv`).",
          data_dir, n, nrow(d), n_drop),
  "",
  sprintf("- **IVW (random effects):** %s mmHg per 1 kg/m2 higher BMI (95%% CI %s to %s).",
          f(ivw_est), f(estimates$ci_lower[1]), f(estimates$ci_upper[1])),
  sprintf("- **MR-Egger:** %s (%s to %s); intercept %s (P = %s).",
          f(egger_slope), f(estimates$ci_lower[2]), f(estimates$ci_upper[2]), f(egger_int), formatC(egger_int_p, digits = 2, format = "g")),
  sprintf("- **Weighted median:** %s (%s to %s).", f(wm_est), f(estimates$ci_lower[4]), f(estimates$ci_upper[4])),
  sprintf("- **Heterogeneity:** Cochran's Q = %.1f on %d df (P = %s).", Q, Q_df, formatC(Q_p, digits = 2, format = "g")),
  "",
  "Exposure effects were converted from SD units to kg/m2 (1 SD = 4.8 kg/m2). Figure: `results/figures/scatter.png`."
)
nw <- length(strsplit(paste(report, collapse = " "), "\\s+")[[1]])
if (nw > 200) warning(sprintf("report.md has %d words (limit 200)", nw))
writeLines(report, file.path(out_dir, "report.md"))
cat("Done. Outputs written under", normalizePath(out_dir), "\n")

  a1 <- d$out_A1[i];        a2 <- d$out_A2[i]   # outcome beta refers to a2

  if (is.na(a2) || is.na(a1)) {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: not in outcome GWAS"; next
  }
  if (is.na(d$out_beta[i]) || is.na(d$out_se[i]) || d$out_se[i] <= 0) {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: outcome beta/se missing"; next
  }

  if (is_palindromic(ea, oa)) {
    maf_x <- min(d$EAF[i], 1 - d$EAF[i])
    maf_y <- if (is.na(d$out_freq[i])) NA else min(d$out_freq[i], 1 - d$out_freq[i])
    if (is.na(maf_y) || maf_x > MAF_PALINDROME_MAX || maf_y > MAF_PALINDROME_MAX) {
      d$action[i] <- "dropped: palindromic, MAF > 0.42 (strand ambiguous)"; next
    }
    if (!((a2 == ea && a1 == oa) || (a2 == oa && a1 == ea))) {
      d$action[i] <- "dropped: alleles do not match"; next
    }
    # Frequency of the exposure effect allele in the outcome if strands agree:
    f_same <- if (a2 == ea) d$out_freq[i] else 1 - d$out_freq[i]
    same_strand <- abs(d$EAF[i] - f_same) <= abs(d$EAF[i] - (1 - f_same))
    # Strands agree -> align by letter. Strands differ -> letters are swapped
    # relative to the same-strand reading, so the alignment is reversed.
    flip <- if (same_strand) (a2 == oa) else (a2 == ea)
    d$beta_y[i] <- if (flip) -d$out_beta[i] else d$out_beta[i]
    d$action[i] <- paste0("palindromic, strand inferred from EAF (",
                          if (same_strand) "same strand" else "opposite strand",
                          if (flip) ", sign flipped)" else ", no flip)")
    d$used[i] <- TRUE
    next
  }

  if (a2 == ea && a1 == oa) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- d$out_beta[i];  d$action[i] <- "aligned: no change"
  } else if (a2 == oa && a1 == ea) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- -d$out_beta[i]; d$action[i] <- "aligned: outcome alleles swapped, sign flipped"
  } else if (comp(a2) == ea && comp(a1) == oa) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- d$out_beta[i];  d$action[i] <- "strand flip: complemented, no sign change"
  } else if (comp(a2) == oa && comp(a1) == ea) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- -d$out_beta[i]; d$action[i] <- "strand flip: complemented, sign flipped"
  } else {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: alleles do not match"; next
  }
  d$used[i] <- TRUE
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. Units
# Exposure: SD units -> per kg/m2. Outcome already mmHg, so ratios are mmHg per kg/m2.
d$beta_x <- d$BETA / SD_BMI_KGM2
d$se_x   <- d$SE   / SD_BMI_KGM2
d$se_y   <- d$out_se

log_df <- data.frame(SNP = d$SNP, CHR = d$CHR, POS = d$POS,
                     exposure_effect_allele = d$EFFECT_ALLELE, exposure_other_allele = d$OTHER_ALLELE,
                     exposure_EAF = d$EAF, outcome_A1 = d$out_A1, outcome_A2 = d$out_A2,
                     outcome_freq_A2 = d$out_freq,
                     action = d$action, used = d$used)
write.csv(log_df, file.path(out_dir, "results", "harmonisation_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

m <- d[d$used, c("SNP", "beta_x", "se_x", "beta_y", "se_y")]
n <- nrow(m)
cat(sprintf("%d of %d exposure variants used after harmonisation\n", n, nrow(d)))
print(table(sub(":.*|,.*| \\(.*", "", d$action)))
if (n < 4) stop("Too few instruments for the sensitivity analyses.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. Estimation
bx <- m$beta_x; by <- m$beta_y; sy <- m$se_y; sx <- m$se_x

# --- IVW, multiplicative random effects (first-order weights 1/se_y^2).
# Slope through origin; residual variance scales the SE, floored at 1
# (no under-dispersion correction). CI uses t with n-1 df.
ivw_fit <- lm(by ~ 0 + bx, weights = 1 / sy^2)
ivw_est <- unname(coef(ivw_fit))
ivw_se_fixed <- summary(ivw_fit)$coefficients[1, 2] / summary(ivw_fit)$sigma
Q <- sum(residuals(ivw_fit)^2 / sy^2)            # Cochran's Q, df = n-1
Q_df <- n - 1
Q_p <- pchisq(Q, Q_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
I2 <- max(0, (Q - Q_df) / Q)
ivw_se <- ivw_se_fixed * max(1, sqrt(Q / Q_df))
ivw_t <- qt(0.975, Q_df)

# --- MR-Egger: orient so every bx is positive, then WLS with intercept.
sg <- sign(bx); sg[sg == 0] <- 1
bx_o <- bx * sg; by_o <- by * sg
egger_fit <- lm(by_o ~ bx_o, weights = 1 / sy^2)
egger_sum <- summary(egger_fit)$coefficients
egger_sigma <- max(1, summary(egger_fit)$sigma)
egger_df <- n - 2
egger_t <- qt(0.975, egger_df)
egger_int <- egger_sum[1, 1]; egger_int_se <- egger_sum[1, 2] / summary(egger_fit)$sigma * egger_sigma
egger_slope <- egger_sum[2, 1]; egger_slope_se <- egger_sum[2, 2] / summary(egger_fit)$sigma * egger_sigma
egger_int_p <- 2 * pt(-abs(egger_int / egger_int_se), egger_df)

# --- Weighted median (Bowden 2016), first-order weights, bootstrap SE.
weighted_median <- function(b, w) {
  o <- order(b); b <- b[o]; w <- w[o] / sum(w)
  p <- cumsum(w) - 0.5 * w
  below <- max(which(p < 0.5))
  b[below] + (b[below + 1] - b[below]) * (0.5 - p[below]) / (p[below + 1] - p[below])
}
wm_est_fun <- function(bx, by, sx_unused, sy) {
  ratio <- by / bx
  se_ratio <- sy / abs(bx)
  weighted_median(ratio, 1 / se_ratio^2)
}
wm_est <- wm_est_fun(bx, by, sx, sy)
wm_boot <- replicate(N_BOOT, {
  bxb <- rnorm(n, bx, sx); byb <- rnorm(n, by, sy)
  wm_est_fun(bxb, byb, sx, sy)
})
wm_se <- sd(wm_boot)

ci <- function(est, se, crit) c(est - crit * se, est + crit * se)
estimates <- data.frame(
  method = c("IVW (multiplicative random effects)", "MR-Egger slope", "MR-Egger intercept", "Weighted median"),
  estimate = c(ivw_est, egger_slope, egger_int, wm_est),
  se = c(ivw_se, egger_slope_se, egger_int_se, wm_se),
  ci_lower = c(ci(ivw_est, ivw_se, ivw_t)[1], ci(egger_slope, egger_slope_se, egger_t)[1],
               ci(egger_int, egger_int_se, egger_t)[1], ci(wm_est, wm_se, qnorm(0.975))[1]),
  ci_upper = c(ci(ivw_est, ivw_se, ivw_t)[2], ci(egger_slope, egger_slope_se, egger_t)[2],
               ci(egger_int, egger_int_se, egger_t)[2], ci(wm_est, wm_se, qnorm(0.975))[2]),
  n_snps = n)
write.csv(estimates, file.path(out_dir, "results", "estimates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(estimates, digits = 4)
cat(sprintf("Cochran's Q (IVW) = %.2f on %d df, P = %.3g, I2 = %.0f%%\n", Q, Q_df, Q_p, 100 * I2))
cat(sprintf("MR-Egger intercept P = %.3g\n", egger_int_p))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Figure
png(file.path(out_dir, "results", "figures", "scatter.png"), width = 1600, height = 1400, res = 220)
xr <- range(c(0, bx_o - 1.96 * sx, bx_o + 1.96 * sx))
yr <- range(c(0, by_o - 1.96 * sy, by_o + 1.96 * sy))
plot(bx_o, by_o, xlim = xr, ylim = yr, pch = 19, col = "grey30",
     xlab = "SNP effect on BMI (kg/m2 per allele)",
     ylab = "SNP effect on SBP (mmHg per allele)",
     main = "BMI -> SBP: SNP-outcome vs SNP-exposure effects")
segments(bx_o, by_o - 1.96 * sy, bx_o, by_o + 1.96 * sy, col = "grey70")
segments(bx_o - 1.96 * sx, by_o, bx_o + 1.96 * sx, by_o, col = "grey70")
abline(h = 0, v = 0, lty = 3, col = "grey60")
abline(a = 0, b = ivw_est, col = "#0072B2", lwd = 2)
abline(a = egger_int, b = egger_slope, col = "#D55E00", lwd = 2)
abline(a = 0, b = wm_est, col = "#009E73", lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", bty = "n", lwd = 2, col = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73"),
       legend = c("IVW", "MR-Egger", "Weighted median"))
dev.off()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- report.md (<= 200 words)
n_drop <- nrow(d) - n
f <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
report <- c(
  "# BMI and systolic blood pressure: two-sample MR (simulated data)",
  "",
  sprintf("Dataset: `%s`. %d of %d BMI instruments were used; %d dropped (missing in the outcome GWAS or ambiguous palindromic variants; see `results/harmonisation_log.csv`).",
          data_dir, n, nrow(d), n_drop),
  "",
  sprintf("- **IVW (random effects):** %s mmHg per 1 kg/m2 higher BMI (95%% CI %s to %s).",
          f(ivw_est), f(estimates$ci_lower[1]), f(estimates$ci_upper[1])),
  sprintf("- **MR-Egger:** %s (%s to %s); intercept %s (P = %s).",
          f(egger_slope), f(estimates$ci_lower[2]), f(estimates$ci_upper[2]), f(egger_int), formatC(egger_int_p, digits = 2, format = "g")),
  sprintf("- **Weighted median:** %s (%s to %s).", f(wm_est), f(estimates$ci_lower[4]), f(estimates$ci_upper[4])),
  sprintf("- **Heterogeneity:** Cochran's Q = %.1f on %d df (P = %s).", Q, Q_df, formatC(Q_p, digits = 2, format = "g")),
  "",
  "Exposure effects were converted from SD units to kg/m2 (1 SD = 4.8 kg/m2). Figure: `results/figures/scatter.png`."
)
nw <- length(strsplit(paste(report, collapse = " "), "\\s+")[[1]])
if (nw > 200) warning(sprintf("report.md has %d words (limit 200)", nw))
writeLines(report, file.path(out_dir, "report.md"))
cat("Done. Outputs written under", normalizePath(out_dir), "\n")

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# Two-sample MR: effect of BMI on systolic blood pressure (mmHg per 1 kg/m2).
# Implements analysis_plan.md. Base R only.
#
# Usage: Rscript analysis/mr_analysis.R [dataset_folder] [output_folder]
#   dataset_folder  default "data/main"
#   output_folder   default "."  (results/ and report.md are written under it)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
data_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1) args[1] else "data/main"
out_dir  <- if (length(args) >= 2) args[2] else "."

SD_BMI_KGM2 <- 4.8      # 1 SD of BMI in kg/m2 (data dictionary)
MAF_PALINDROME_MAX <- 0.42
MISSING_CODE <- -9
N_BOOT <- 1000
set.seed(20240101)

dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "results", "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. Read and clean
exp <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "exposure_bmi_gwas.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
out <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "outcome_sbp_gwas.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# outcome missing code -> NA (in every numeric column)
for (v in c("chr", "pos", "freq", "beta", "se", "pval", "n")) {
  if (v %in% names(out)) out[[v]][out[[v]] %in% MISSING_CODE] <- NA
}
exp$EFFECT_ALLELE <- toupper(trimws(exp$EFFECT_ALLELE))
exp$OTHER_ALLELE  <- toupper(trimws(exp$OTHER_ALLELE))
out$A1 <- toupper(trimws(out$A1))
out$A2 <- toupper(trimws(out$A2))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(exp$SNP))
if (anyDuplicated(out$rsid)) {
  warning("Duplicated rsid in outcome file; keeping first occurrence of each.")
  out <- out[!duplicated(out$rsid), ]
}

comp <- function(a) chartr("ACGT", "TGCA", a)
is_palindromic <- function(a1, a2) paste0(a1, a2) %in% c("AT", "TA", "CG", "GC")

# One row per exposure variant; the log is built from this table.
d <- merge(exp, out[, c("rsid", "A1", "A2", "freq", "beta", "se")],
           by.x = "SNP", by.y = "rsid", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
names(d)[names(d) == "A1"]   <- "out_A1"
names(d)[names(d) == "A2"]   <- "out_A2"
names(d)[names(d) == "freq"] <- "out_freq"
names(d)[names(d) == "beta"] <- "out_beta"
names(d)[names(d) == "se"]   <- "out_se"
d <- d[match(exp$SNP, d$SNP), ]   # keep exposure file order

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. Harmonise
# Goal: out_beta_h = effect of the EXPOSURE effect allele on SBP.
d$action <- NA_character_
d$used   <- FALSE
d$beta_y <- NA_real_

for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
  ea <- d$EFFECT_ALLELE[i]; oa <- d$OTHER_ALLELE[i]
  a1 <- d$out_A1[i];        a2 <- d$out_A2[i]   # outcome beta refers to a2

  if (is.na(a2) || is.na(a1)) {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: not in outcome GWAS"; next
  }
  if (is.na(d$out_beta[i]) || is.na(d$out_se[i]) || d$out_se[i] <= 0) {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: outcome beta/se missing"; next
  }

  if (is_palindromic(ea, oa)) {
    maf_x <- min(d$EAF[i], 1 - d$EAF[i])
    maf_y <- if (is.na(d$out_freq[i])) NA else min(d$out_freq[i], 1 - d$out_freq[i])
    if (is.na(maf_y) || maf_x > MAF_PALINDROME_MAX || maf_y > MAF_PALINDROME_MAX) {
      d$action[i] <- "dropped: palindromic, MAF > 0.42 (strand ambiguous)"; next
    }
    if (!((a2 == ea && a1 == oa) || (a2 == oa && a1 == ea))) {
      d$action[i] <- "dropped: alleles do not match"; next
    }
    # Frequency of the exposure effect allele in the outcome if strands agree:
    f_same <- if (a2 == ea) d$out_freq[i] else 1 - d$out_freq[i]
    same_strand <- abs(d$EAF[i] - f_same) <= abs(d$EAF[i] - (1 - f_same))
    # Strands agree -> align by letter. Strands differ -> letters are swapped
    # relative to the same-strand reading, so the alignment is reversed.
    flip <- if (same_strand) (a2 == oa) else (a2 == ea)
    d$beta_y[i] <- if (flip) -d$out_beta[i] else d$out_beta[i]
    d$action[i] <- paste0("palindromic, strand inferred from EAF (",
                          if (same_strand) "same strand" else "opposite strand",
                          if (flip) ", sign flipped)" else ", no flip)")
    d$used[i] <- TRUE
    next
  }

  if (a2 == ea && a1 == oa) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- d$out_beta[i];  d$action[i] <- "aligned: no change"
  } else if (a2 == oa && a1 == ea) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- -d$out_beta[i]; d$action[i] <- "aligned: outcome alleles swapped, sign flipped"
  } else if (comp(a2) == ea && comp(a1) == oa) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- d$out_beta[i];  d$action[i] <- "strand flip: complemented, no sign change"
  } else if (comp(a2) == oa && comp(a1) == ea) {
    d$beta_y[i] <- -d$out_beta[i]; d$action[i] <- "strand flip: complemented, sign flipped"
  } else {
    d$action[i] <- "dropped: alleles do not match"; next
  }
  d$used[i] <- TRUE
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. Units
# Exposure: SD units -> per kg/m2. Outcome already mmHg, so ratios are mmHg per kg/m2.
d$beta_x <- d$BETA / SD_BMI_KGM2
d$se_x   <- d$SE   / SD_BMI_KGM2
d$se_y   <- d$out_se

log_df <- data.frame(SNP = d$SNP, CHR = d$CHR, POS = d$POS,
                     exposure_effect_allele = d$EFFECT_ALLELE, exposure_other_allele = d$OTHER_ALLELE,
                     exposure_EAF = d$EAF, outcome_A1 = d$out_A1, outcome_A2 = d$out_A2,
                     outcome_freq_A2 = d$out_freq,
                     action = d$action, used = d$used)
write.csv(log_df, file.path(out_dir, "results", "harmonisation_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

m <- d[d$used, c("SNP", "beta_x", "se_x", "beta_y", "se_y")]
n <- nrow(m)
cat(sprintf("%d of %d exposure variants used after harmonisation\n", n, nrow(d)))
print(table(sub(":.*|,.*| \\(.*", "", d$action)))
if (n < 4) stop("Too few instruments for the sensitivity analyses.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. Estimation
bx <- m$beta_x; by <- m$beta_y; sy <- m$se_y; sx <- m$se_x

# --- IVW, multiplicative random effects (first-order weights 1/se_y^2).
# Slope through origin; residual variance scales the SE, floored at 1
# (no under-dispersion correction). CI uses t with n-1 df.
ivw_fit <- lm(by ~ 0 + bx, weights = 1 / sy^2)
ivw_est <- unname(coef(ivw_fit))
ivw_se_fixed <- summary(ivw_fit)$coefficients[1, 2] / summary(ivw_fit)$sigma
Q <- sum(residuals(ivw_fit)^2 / sy^2)            # Cochran's Q, df = n-1
Q_df <- n - 1
Q_p <- pchisq(Q, Q_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
I2 <- max(0, (Q - Q_df) / Q)
ivw_se <- ivw_se_fixed * max(1, sqrt(Q / Q_df))
ivw_t <- qt(0.975, Q_df)

# --- MR-Egger: orient so every bx is positive, then WLS with intercept.
sg <- sign(bx); sg[sg == 0] <- 1
bx_o <- bx * sg; by_o <- by * sg
egger_fit <- lm(by_o ~ bx_o, weights = 1 / sy^2)
egger_sum <- summary(egger_fit)$coefficients
egger_sigma <- max(1, summary(egger_fit)$sigma)
egger_df <- n - 2
egger_t <- qt(0.975, egger_df)
egger_int <- egger_sum[1, 1]; egger_int_se <- egger_sum[1, 2] / summary(egger_fit)$sigma * egger_sigma
egger_slope <- egger_sum[2, 1]; egger_slope_se <- egger_sum[2, 2] / summary(egger_fit)$sigma * egger_sigma
egger_int_p <- 2 * pt(-abs(egger_int / egger_int_se), egger_df)

# --- Weighted median (Bowden 2016), first-order weights, bootstrap SE.
weighted_median <- function(b, w) {
  o <- order(b); b <- b[o]; w <- w[o] / sum(w)
  p <- cumsum(w) - 0.5 * w
  below <- max(which(p < 0.5))
  b[below] + (b[below + 1] - b[below]) * (0.5 - p[below]) / (p[below + 1] - p[below])
}
wm_est_fun <- function(bx, by, sx_unused, sy) {
  ratio <- by / bx
  se_ratio <- sy / abs(bx)
  weighted_median(ratio, 1 / se_ratio^2)
}
wm_est <- wm_est_fun(bx, by, sx, sy)
wm_boot <- replicate(N_BOOT, {
  bxb <- rnorm(n, bx, sx); byb <- rnorm(n, by, sy)
  wm_est_fun(bxb, byb, sx, sy)
})
wm_se <- sd(wm_boot)

ci <- function(est, se, crit) c(est - crit * se, est + crit * se)
estimates <- data.frame(
  method = c("IVW (multiplicative random effects)", "MR-Egger slope", "MR-Egger intercept", "Weighted median"),
  estimate = c(ivw_est, egger_slope, egger_int, wm_est),
  se = c(ivw_se, egger_slope_se, egger_int_se, wm_se),
  ci_lower = c(ci(ivw_est, ivw_se, ivw_t)[1], ci(egger_slope, egger_slope_se, egger_t)[1],
               ci(egger_int, egger_int_se, egger_t)[1], ci(wm_est, wm_se, qnorm(0.975))[1]),
  ci_upper = c(ci(ivw_est, ivw_se, ivw_t)[2], ci(egger_slope, egger_slope_se, egger_t)[2],
               ci(egger_int, egger_int_se, egger_t)[2], ci(wm_est, wm_se, qnorm(0.975))[2]),
  n_snps = n)
write.csv(estimates, file.path(out_dir, "results", "estimates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(estimates, digits = 4)
cat(sprintf("Cochran's Q (IVW) = %.2f on %d df, P = %.3g, I2 = %.0f%%\n", Q, Q_df, Q_p, 100 * I2))
cat(sprintf("MR-Egger intercept P = %.3g\n", egger_int_p))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Figure
png(file.path(out_dir, "results", "figures", "scatter.png"), width = 1600, height = 1400, res = 220)
xr <- range(c(0, bx_o - 1.96 * sx, bx_o + 1.96 * sx))
yr <- range(c(0, by_o - 1.96 * sy, by_o + 1.96 * sy))
plot(bx_o, by_o, xlim = xr, ylim = yr, pch = 19, col = "grey30",
     xlab = "SNP effect on BMI (kg/m2 per allele)",
     ylab = "SNP effect on SBP (mmHg per allele)",
     main = "BMI -> SBP: SNP-outcome vs SNP-exposure effects")
segments(bx_o, by_o - 1.96 * sy, bx_o, by_o + 1.96 * sy, col = "grey70")
segments(bx_o - 1.96 * sx, by_o, bx_o + 1.96 * sx, by_o, col = "grey70")
abline(h = 0, v = 0, lty = 3, col = "grey60")
abline(a = 0, b = ivw_est, col = "#0072B2", lwd = 2)
abline(a = egger_int, b = egger_slope, col = "#D55E00", lwd = 2)
abline(a = 0, b = wm_est, col = "#009E73", lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", bty = "n", lwd = 2, col = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73"),
       legend = c("IVW", "MR-Egger", "Weighted median"))
dev.off()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- report.md (<= 200 words)
n_drop <- nrow(d) - n
f <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
report <- c(
  "# BMI and systolic blood pressure: two-sample MR (simulated data)",
  "",
  sprintf("Dataset: `%s`. %d of %d BMI instruments were used; %d dropped (missing in the outcome GWAS or ambiguous palindromic variants; see `results/harmonisation_log.csv`).",
          data_dir, n, nrow(d), n_drop),
  "",
  sprintf("- **IVW (random effects):** %s mmHg per 1 kg/m2 higher BMI (95%% CI %s to %s).",
          f(ivw_est), f(estimates$ci_lower[1]), f(estimates$ci_upper[1])),
  sprintf("- **MR-Egger:** %s (%s to %s); intercept %s (P = %s).",
          f(egger_slope), f(estimates$ci_lower[2]), f(estimates$ci_upper[2]), f(egger_int), formatC(egger_int_p, digits = 2, format = "g")),
  sprintf("- **Weighted median:** %s (%s to %s).", f(wm_est), f(estimates$ci_lower[4]), f(estimates$ci_upper[4])),
  sprintf("- **Heterogeneity:** Cochran's Q = %.1f on %d df (P = %s).", Q, Q_df, formatC(Q_p, digits = 2, format = "g")),
  "",
  "Exposure effects were converted from SD units to kg/m2 (1 SD = 4.8 kg/m2). Figure: `results/figures/scatter.png`."
)
nw <- length(strsplit(paste(report, collapse = " "), "\\s+")[[1]])
if (nw > 200) warning(sprintf("report.md has %d words (limit 200)", nw))
writeLines(report, file.path(out_dir, "report.md"))
cat("Done. Outputs written under", normalizePath(out_dir), "\n")

I wrote `analysis/mr_analysis.R` and have not run it, so none of it is tested. Usage is `Rscript analysis/mr_analysis.R [dataset_folder] [output_folder]`. The dataset folder defaults to `data/main`.

I added a second optional argument, the output folder, which defaults to `.`. Without it, a run on `control_positive` would overwrite the `main` results.

How the script follows the plan:

1. **Read and clean.**
   - It reads both TSVs and converts the outcome's `-9` code to `NA` in every numeric column.
   - It builds one row per exposure variant, so the log covers every variant.
   - Variants absent from the outcome file, or with missing outcome beta or SE, are dropped and logged with that reason.

2. **Harmonise.**
   - The target is the effect of the exposure effect allele on SBP. The outcome `beta` and `freq` refer to `A2`, so the script flips the sign when `A2` is the exposure's other allele.
   - Strand differences are handled by complementing the outcome alleles and re-matching. Alleles that match neither way are dropped.
   - For palindromic variants, the script drops the variant if either the exposure or outcome minor allele frequency is above 0.42.
   - Otherwise it compares the exposure `EAF` with the outcome frequency read both ways. The closer reading decides whether the strands agree, and so whether to flip the sign.
   - Every variant gets an `action` string and a `used` flag in `results/harmonisation_log.csv`.

3. **Units.** Exposure `BETA` and `SE` are divided by 4.8, giving kg/m² units. The outcome is already in mmHg, so the estimates come out in mmHg per kg/m².

4. **Estimate.**
   - **IVW:** a weighted regression through the origin with weights 1/se_y². The standard error is scaled by the residual variance, with a floor of 1 so it never shrinks below the fixed-effect value. The confidence interval uses a t distribution on n−1 df. Cochran's Q, its P-value and I² are printed.
   - **MR-Egger:** variants are oriented so every exposure effect is positive, then fitted by weighted regression with an intercept. The intercept's SE, P-value and CI use the same variance floor and a t distribution on n−2 df.
   - **Weighted median:** Bowden's method with first-order weights. The SE comes from a parametric bootstrap of 1000 draws, seeded, and the CI is normal.

5. **Outputs.**
   - `results/estimates.csv` has the columns `method, estimate, se, ci_lower, ci_upper, n_snps`. I put the Egger intercept in as its own row.
   - `results/figures/scatter.png` shows the oriented SNP–outcome against SNP–exposure effects with error bars, and the IVW, Egger and weighted median lines.
   - `report.md` is generated from the results by a template of about 120 words, and the script warns if it goes over 200. It states the numbers and the instrument counts but offers no interpretation, so you may want to edit it.

The script stops if fewer than 4 instruments survive harmonisation.

Choices worth checking when you read it: the stricter reading of the palindromic MAF rule (either dataset above 0.42), the variance floor, and the first-order weights.
